section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and procedure for a single study. Data was collected online via Amazon's Mechanical Turk from 399 U.S. workers (199 women, 200 men) in January 2016. The final sample had a mean age of 34.55 years, a mean self-reported BMI of 26.62, and was predominantly White (81.7%), with 66.3% having an undergraduate or postgraduate degree.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and procedure for a single online study conducted via Amazon's Mechanical Turk (MTurk) in January 2016. Participants were recruited from the U.S. and completed measures hosted on Qualtrics. The final sample (Study X) consisted of 199 women and 200 men, with demographic information provided for age, self-reported BMI, race (81.7% White), and education level (68.8% college or higher).

Asset Caption.extract_value: Fig. 1. The hypothesised model. Internalisation of the thin ideal was included as a mediator for women and internalisation of the muscular ideal as a mediator for men. Investment in appearance is presented as a single variable here for parsimony, but included self-evaluative and motivational salience, respectively.
